name: Tome of Divinity
summary: Tome of Divinity is a summons directed at developing human paladins visiting Ironforge. Master Brandur Ironhammer bids initiates make the journey south to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind, where Master Duthorian Rall oversees advanced training in the sacred Tomes of Divinity.

sections.title: A Summons from Stormwind
sections.body: While dwarven paladins train vigorously beneath the stone arches of Ironforge's High Seat, the broader traditions of the Silver Hand remain deeply entwined with the Church of the Holy Light in human lands. Word sent north from Stormwind calls on promising holy warriors to present themselves directly before the senior priesthood and paladin mentors of the Cathedral of Light.

sections.title: The Road to the Cathedral
sections.body: Master Brandur Ironhammer recognizes when a student has progressed far enough to step into the deeper mysteries of the faith. Journeying south—whether by the subterranean Deeprun Tram or across the mountain passes—brings initiates to Stormwind's Cathedral District, where Duthorian Rall prepares them to study the sacred Tomes and master the rites of redemption.

faq.q: Why is an Ironforge trainer sending me to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind's Cathedral of Light serves as the administrative heart for advanced Alliance paladin instruction. Brandur Ironhammer directs promising initiates to Master Duthorian Rall so they can undertake the specific canonical trials associated with the sacred Tomes of Divinity.

Brandur Ironhammer is a dwarven paladin trainer based in Ironforge's High Seat. He watches over initiates, instructing them in martial devotion and guiding them toward higher studies when their inner connection to the Holy Light matures.

Duthorian Rall is a senior paladin trainer and prelate stationed inside the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. He directly tests aspiring paladins through rigorous spiritual trials before entrusting them with the Tomes of Divinity.

faq.q: What are the Tomes of Divinity?
faq.answer: The Tomes of Divinity are sacred texts and doctrinal handbooks used by the Church of the Holy Light to teach paladins the solemn rites of resurrection, self-sacrifice, and unwavering compassion.

faq.q: What is the fastest way to reach Stormwind from Ironforge?
faq.answer: The quickest and safest route is the Deeprun Tram, an engineering marvel located inside Ironforge's Tinker Town that carries travelers straight beneath the mountains into the heart of Stormwind.

faq.q: Is this trial required for all Alliance paladins?
aliases: do dwarves have to do this
faq.answer: No. This summons is for human paladins, who study the Tomes under Duthorian Rall in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. Dwarven paladins begin their own Tome of Divinity trials in Ironforge with Tiza Battleforge.

angles.text: This quest marks your official transition from a mere martial novice into an ordained servant of the Holy Light capable of channeling its most profound restorative miracles.
Dwarven paladins have forged their own proud traditions in Khaz Modan, taking up the Tomes of Divinity in Ironforge even as their human brethren are summoned to Stormwind.
The shared training of holy warriors in Stormwind strengthens the spiritual and military bond uniting Ironforge and the kingdom of Stormwind.
